content: The function SomeIpXf_ExtractProtocolHeader- Fields specified in [SWS_SomeIpXf_91001] shall check whether the provided bufferLength is larger or equal than the size of the protocol header processed by the SOME/IP transformer (i.e., 8 bytes).  If this is not the case, E_NOT_OK shall be returned. Neither messageType nor messageResult shall be modified in this case.
